pages.title: Litz Wire
pages.text: Hundreds of thin copper strands, each insulated and woven so every one takes its turn at the outside: at high frequency current crowds to a wire's skin, and this gives it more skin.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Combinatorics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bending Magnet, Central Solenoid, Toroidal Field Coil.
